Open Challenge to the Army of Christ the Lord (AOCTL)
The Special Forces of Hawazan hereby challenge the Army of Christ the Lord (AOCTL) to a 3v3 or 2v2 war battle.

The following rules will apply:

1. Only members of Hawazan and AOCTL are allowed to participate. No allies or outside members will be allowed to represent either side.

2. Both sides must have an equal number of players. The battle can be 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3.

3. If the battle is 1v1 or 2v2, employees from BCBN will be invited to join the server to fill the remaining slots, record the battle, and determine the winner.

4. The date and time will be decided through mutual agreement between both sides.

Statement
This is an open challenge to AOCTL. They like to portray themselves as crusaders and act as if they are some capable fighting force, but when it comes to actually fighting, they fail to deliver. They talk a lot, but we have yet to see them prove themselves.

If AOCTL refuses this challenge, we will take it as an acceptance of defeat. If they cannot even agree to a fair fight under equal conditions, then they have no reason to boast about their combat abilities or expect recognition as a capable faction.

The challenge is open. Let's see if AOCTL is willing to accept it.

SPECIAL FORCES HQ
HAWAZAN

# BCC Says Its Staff Member Spied Inside GOC for Over a Week

A **Black Cats Central (BCC)** staff member, **Snazzy**, says they spent more than a week inside the **GOC**'s server as a spy, and BCC is now making a series of claims about the faction.

According to BCC, the operation was "an attempt to understand the other factions' way of running things." BCC claims it found that the GOC lacks control, power, members and "especially loyalty."

BCC also claims it leaked **everyone in the GOC's server, its entire chain of command, and most of its tactics**. BCC believes the GOC had its own spy inside BCC and calls the situation "a 1 to 1 trade."

BCC further claims the GOC attacked it in several waves, fighting 1v3 and losing every time, while telling its own server that it had won. BCC says it has photo evidence of this, but BCBN has not seen it.

"It's amazing, the incompetence the GOC had for claiming they'd win the war, for letting a member of the BCC staff walk in and spy for over a week," Snazzy said.

The GOC has not responded at the time of writing. BCBN hasn't independently verified any of these claims.

We'll update this story as it develops.
